title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM
abstract: arXiv:2610.20415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Poor generalisation in deep neural networks is frequently associated with convergence to sharp minima. Sharpness-Aware Minimisation (SAM) improves generalisation of deep neural networks by minimising a combination of the training loss and the local sharpness of the loss landscape, biasing convergence towards flat minima. However, SAM relies on a fixed perturbation radius $\rho$ that ignores local curvature, leading to inefficient behaviour: the perturbation may be too small to escape poor basins defined by sharp local minima, or too large to allow convergence to solutions with good loss-sharpness tradeoff. We reinterpret $\rho$ as the intensity of the perturbation signal and propose Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM (CAP-SAM), a geometry-aware method that modulates the perturbation radius based on a sharpness ratio, enabling a more effective search for robust minima on the loss landscape. translated_title: 一种尺寸无法适配所有情况：面向SAM的曲率感知自适应扰动
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络泛化能力差的问题常常与收敛到尖锐极小值有关。锐度感知最小化（SAM）通过同时最小化训练损失和损失景观的局部锐度，使模型收敛偏向平坦极小值，从而改善深度神经网络的泛化能力。然而，SAM依赖于固定的扰动半径ρ，忽略了局部曲率，导致低效的行为：扰动半径可能太小而无法逃离由尖锐局部极小值所定义的不良盆地，也可能太大而无法收敛到具有良好损失-锐度权衡的解。我们将ρ重新解释为扰动信号的强度，并提出了面向SAM的曲率感知自适应扰动方法（CAP-SAM），这是一种几何感知的方法，基于锐度比率来调节扰动半径，从而能够在损失景观上更有效地搜索鲁棒极小值。我们证明了CAP-SAM保持了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CAP-SAM方法，通过基于锐度比率自适应地调节SAM的扰动半径，克服了固定扰动半径忽略局部曲率的缺陷，从而在损失景观上更有效地搜索鲁棒极小值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CAP-SAM, which adaptively modulates SAM's perturbation radius based on a sharpness ratio, overcoming the limitation of a fixed radius that ignores local curvature and enabling a more effective search for robust minima on the loss landscape.
